title: Charred Plum and Tomato Risotto
description: A gluten-free, Italian-inspired risotto dish featuring charred plums and tomatoes.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add risotto and cook for 2-3 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add 1 cup of water and stir until absorbed. Repeat until all water is used.
While risotto is cooking, char the plums and tomatoes on a grill or grill pan.
Add charred plums and tomatoes to the risotto and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: top with additional charred fruit or a drizzle of balsamic glaze.
